---
title: "Recipes"
---

Every recipe is SQL you run yourself: press **Run** under a block and it executes in
your browser, against the latest release, through DuckDB-Wasm. Nothing runs
until you press it, and the first run downloads DuckDB itself, a few MB. The
results are always the current release's, and the SQL shown is exactly the SQL
that ran, so you can also open it in the DuckDB Shell or copy it into your own
DuckDB.

Queries are scoped (one state, one measure, one source release) so each run
reads a few megabytes. Full scans of `measure.observation` are slow in a
browser tab and can run out of its memory; for those, use DuckDB on your own
machine ([Versions and citation](/guides/versions-and-citation.qmd)). If a
run fails, the message appears under the block; reloading the page starts a
fresh DuckDB-Wasm.
